ios.desc:
Your hyperspace command center. Control, personalize, and interact with your HyperCube. There are 3 modes (Kaleidoscopic, Sound Reactive, and Meditative), and over 90 unique patters to choose from and customize. Features of the app include:

- Select mode or individual patterns from a list
- Choose custom colors (up to 3 at once), or choose from predefined color palettes
- Change brightness or pattern speed
- Adjust pattern intensity, with different effects on each unique pattern
- Change symmetry, the direction that light pulses through the cube
- Save favorites (up to 16), along with any customization you've made
- Audio response, sync the brightness of any pattern to the music
- Hyper-sync, automatically syncing the color and pattern of any HyperCube in the network

This app uses WiFi to connect, and is free to all users!
